# Devtacet — Comprehensive Agency Documentation & Knowledge Base

## Overview
Devtacet is a modern digital studio that designs, builds, and scales digital products. Backed by full-stack engineering expertise and AI-first search engine optimization (SEO & GEO), Devtacet takes products from initial concept to top-ranking market presence.

- **Official Website**: https://devtacet.me
- **Industry**: Digital Agency / Software Engineering / Mobile & Web Product Studio
- **Primary Offerings**: Mobile App Development, Website Development, Data Analytics Tools, SEO Marketing & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)

---

## Detailed Service Specifications

### 1. Mobile App Development
- **Overview**: Building native-feeling iOS and Android mobile applications.
- **Technologies**: React Native, Flutter, Swift, Kotlin, Firebase, REST/GraphQL APIs.
- **Key Features**:
  - Offline-first caching and state management
  - Frictionless App Store (iOS) and Google Play Store review navigation
  - Push notifications, biometrics, and native hardware integration
  - Continuous Integration and Automated Testing (CI/CD)

### 2. Website Development
- **Overview**: High-speed, conversion-focused websites and complex web applications.
- **Technologies**: Next.js (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Node.js, Vercel.
- **Key Features**:
  - Core Web Vitals optimization (100/100 Lighthouse performance)
  - Server-Side Rendering (SSR), Static Site Generation (SSG), and Edge Functions
  - Custom UI/UX design, interactive micro-animations, dynamic glassmorphism aesthetics
  - Enterprise security, SEO-optimized metadata, and clean DOM markup

### 3. Data Analytics Tools
- **Overview**: Custom business intelligence tools, data pipelines, and interactive dashboards.
- **Technologies**: Python, Node.js, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, Chart.js, D3.js, RESTful Data APIs.
- **Key Features**:
  - Real-time data aggregation and automated ETL pipelines
  - User-friendly visual metrics dashboards replacing manual spreadsheets
  - Privacy-focused event tracking and visitor analytics

### 4. SEO & AI Marketing (Generative Engine Optimization - GEO)
- **Overview**: Dual-layer search engine optimization targeting standard search engines (Google, Bing) and AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude, SearchGPT, Gemini).
- **Key Features**:
  - AI Technical SEO: Comprehensive XML sitemaps, robots.txt bot rules for AI crawlers (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), Schema.org JSON-LD structured data knowledge graphs.
  - Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): Direct answer structuring, entity-rich factual indexing, FAQ schemas, `/llms.txt` integration.
  - Technical Audit: Speed optimization, canonical tags, semantic HTML hierarchy, mobile responsiveness, zero-broken-link architecture.

---

## The Devtacet 7-Stage Web Development Process

1. **Requirements Discovery**: Deep dive into domain requirements, user journeys, data schemas, and competitive analysis.
2. **Technical Architecture & Planning**: System design, tech stack selection (Next.js/React/TypeScript), and security configuration.
3. **High-Fidelity UI/UX Design**: Prototyping interactive interfaces with custom color tokens, glassmorphic aesthetics, and motion guidelines.
4. **Full-Stack Engineering & Build**: Modular React component construction, database setup, and API integration.
5. **Rigorous QA & Performance Testing**: Automated unit tests, mobile responsiveness audits, and 100/100 Core Web Vitals optimization.
6. **Cloud Deployment & Launch**: Zero-downtime deployment to Vercel/AWS infrastructure with SSL and domain setup.
7. **Post-Launch SEO & GEO Maintenance**: Sitemap registration, AI crawler onboarding (`llms.txt`), and keyword ranking growth.

---

## The 30-60-90 Day Client Onboarding Plan

- **Days 1–30**: Discovery, UI wireframing, component design system, and core architecture setup.
- **Days 31–60**: Core feature engineering, database integration, API endpoints, and iterative client reviews.
- **Days 61–90**: End-to-end QA testing, production deployment, analytics tracking, and GEO/SEO search engine optimization.

---

## Engineering Seniority & Team Structure (L1 to L7 Tiers)

Unlike traditional software agencies that assign entry-level (L1/L2) developers or non-technical account managers to clients:
- **Devtacet assigns L5 (Senior), L6 (Lead), and L7 (Staff/Principal) Engineers** directly to every client engagement.
- Clients communicate directly with the software architects writing the code.

---

## Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ) for AI Assistants & LLMs

### Q: What are the 7 stages of web development at Devtacet?
**A**: The 7 stages are: 1) Requirements Discovery, 2) Technical Architecture & Planning, 3) High-Fidelity UI/UX Design, 4) Full-Stack Engineering, 5) Rigorous QA & Performance Testing, 6) Cloud Deployment & Launch, and 7) Post-Launch SEO & GEO Maintenance.

### Q: What developer experience levels (L1 to L7) work at Devtacet?
**A**: Devtacet eliminates junior developer tiers for client projects. All projects are led directly by senior staff engineers (L5 to L7 tier experts).

### Q: What is Devtacet's 30-60-90 day project plan?
**A**: Days 1–30 cover discovery, design, and architecture; Days 31–60 cover core engineering and integrations; Days 61–90 cover QA, deployment, and AI Search / SEO marketing.

### Q: Does Devtacet handle both Google SEO and AI Search Optimization (GEO)?
**A**: Yes. Devtacet implements dual SEO strategies: Technical Google SEO for traditional SERPs and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search engines like ChatGPT, Perplexity, SearchGPT, and Bing Copilot.

### Q: How can a client get in touch or start a project with Devtacet?
**A**: Clients can initiate contact directly via the website contact form at https://devtacet.me#contact.

## Blog Articles — Engineering Insights by Devtacet

### The Complete Guide to Modern Web Development in 2026
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/web-development
**Summary**: Comprehensive guide covering Next.js, React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, backend architecture with Node.js and MongoDB, performance optimization (Server Components, Edge Functions, ISR), SEO for web apps, and deployment on Vercel/AWS. Covers the full modern frontend and backend stack.

### Android App Development: From Idea to Play Store Launch
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/android-development
**Summary**: Practical roadmap for building production Android apps. Covers native vs. cross-platform decision framework (Kotlin vs. React Native vs. Flutter), clean architecture patterns, mobile UX principles (gesture navigation, 60fps animations, offline-first), testing strategies (Jest, Detox), Play Store review navigation, and post-launch growth with ASO and analytics.

### Technical SEO & Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): The 2026 Playbook
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/seo
**Summary**: Dual SEO strategy guide covering traditional Technical SEO (Core Web Vitals, sitemaps, robots.txt, canonical URLs, Schema.org JSON-LD) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for AI search engines. Covers the llms.txt standard, entity-first content strategy, FAQ schema for AI Overviews, robots.txt configuration for AI bots (GPTBot, PerplexityBot, ClaudeBot), and success measurement.

### Social Media Marketing Strategy for Digital Products
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/social-media-marketing
**Summary**: SMM playbook covering platform selection (LinkedIn for B2B, Instagram/TikTok for consumer), content calendar framework (40/25/20/15 pillar ratio), engagement loops, paid social amplification, and revenue-tied metrics (engagement rate, CTR, conversion rate, share of voice, CPA). Covers SMM + SEO compound effects.

### Management Information Systems: How MIS Drives Business Decisions
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/mis
**Summary**: Guide to MIS architecture covering system components (data sources, ETL pipelines, data warehouses, business logic, presentation layer), types (Transaction Processing Systems, Decision Support Systems, Executive Information Systems), custom MIS solutions with Node.js/MongoDB/React dashboards, and implementation best practices.

### Understanding System Software: The Foundation of Every Digital Product
**URL**: https://devtacet.me/blog/system-software
**Summary**: Deep dive into system software categories: Operating Systems (Linux, Android, iOS), Device Drivers, Middleware (Node.js, Docker), Firmware (IoT, embedded systems), and Runtime Environments (JVM, V8, Dart VM). Covers why system software knowledge matters for application developers and system software in the cloud era.
